AbstractText.Label: BACKGROUND
AbstractText.content: PulseRider (Pulsar Vascular, Los Gatos, CA, USA) is a new endovascular device designed to treat wide neck bifurcation intracranial aneurysms. Deployment of a stent through a PulseRider to treat an aneurysm's recurrence has never been described before.

AbstractText.Label: CASE DESCRIPTION
AbstractText.content: We report the case of a 55-year-old man who underwent coiling of a 8 mm anterior communicating artery aneurysm with assistance of a PulseRider neck reconstruction device. The 6-month digital subtraction angiography control showed aneurysm recurrence, so we deployed an Enterprise 2 closed-cell stent (Codman, Miami Lakes, FL, USA) in the A1-A2 segment passing across the previously implanted PulseRider. Enterprise correctly expanded and allowed for adequate coiling of the aneurysm.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: Enterprise stent can be safely opened through a PulseRider in order to treat aneurysm recurrence.
